answers: decisions.b's message of ~00:10 UTC explaining 35, 36, 38, 41 and the scheduled tasks, with its suggested one-line answer.

decisions.35: Dropped: the sovereignwebsite.ai keeper (website.b) starts with SovereignWebsite__Website attached.
decisions.19: Keeper agents per domain, as proposed by sites.b (website.b, principles.b), confirmed.
decisions.conductors: Locked down: conductors do almost nothing themselves. They coordinate, receive data and manage the agents behind them.
decisions.36 transfers: Dinis does not want to approve each transfer. The first batch of transfers runs without per-transfer approval; from the next batch on, transfers need his approval.
decisions.38 and relays: Yes to 38 (0048389, policy/abp.json state text only). Changes like this, good edits that agents' rules hold for Dinis's word, are covered by a decisions.b record carrying his words; agents should not need him to say yes in their own session. Which kinds of always-ask change this covers in general is to be discussed; 38 is covered now.
decisions.41 and stuck agents: Problems like 41 must not reach Dinis. If an agent gets stuck or loops, tell it how it is done elsewhere; if it is still stuck, archive that session and start a new one.

interpretation: decisions.b reads 'Yeah, absolutely' as yes to agents creating and managing their own scheduled tasks, and 'managing the agents behind them' as including hand-overs to fresh sessions. Dinis corrects either if wrong.
note: A choice, not a push. The 38 push has its own record, 2026-11-23__policy-dns-state.
